businesses.business: title insurance and real estate settlement services

offering_description.value: Provides title insurance policies and closing, escrow and settlement services for residential and commercial real estate transactions. Sells to homebuyers, lenders, real estate professionals and investors through direct operations and independent agents. Also provides related search, valuation and mortgage services.

primary_services.value: escrow and closing services; title searches and examination; real estate information and data services; appraisal management; 1031 exchange and mortgage-related services

customer_segment.value: B2C: homebuyers and sellers purchasing or refinancing homes; B2B: mortgage lenders, real estate brokers, attorneys, builders, commercial investors and developers

end_markets.value: residential real estate; commercial real estate; mortgage lending

revenue_model.value: interest or premiums: title insurance premiums from direct operations and independent agents; service fees: escrow, closing, search and settlement fees; transaction or usage fees: real estate data, valuation and appraisal management fees
revenue_model.category: interest or premiums; service fees; transaction or usage fees

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: underwrites title risk and issues policies for real estate buyers, lenders and agents; service provider: performs title searches, escrow and closing for real estate transactions

geography_served.value: global: Primarily United States, plus Canada, UK, Australia and other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: title insurance, escrow and closing services, real estate data and mortgage-related services

distribution_channels.value: own locations: company-owned title and escrow offices; agents / brokers: independent title agents issuing policies; direct sales: commercial and lender relationships, national accounts
distribution_channels.category: own locations; agents / brokers; direct sales

regulatory_exposure.value: high: title insurance underwriting regulated by state insurance departments, also CFPB and RESPA rules
